bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to African Career Education and Resource, Inc.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AFRICAN CAREER EDUCATION AND RESOURCE, INC.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for grants to African Career Education and Resource, Inc. for programming; public education classes, events, and forums; community outreach and engagement; and cultural events and classes to teach the public about the historical, cultural, and folk arts heritage of African Minnesotans.
